name: acryl-db-sqlite
description: The SQLite provider of the db port: one node:sqlite file in the app home (WAL), the app's numbered migrations applied on start, db provided to plugins. Vendored from ACRYL.
mount: mount it after instance: root.plugin(dbSqlite, { migrations: 'migrations' }) with the migrations/ folder (001-name.sql, ...) next to src/; then a plugin that declares inject: ['db'] calls await ctx.db.all('SELECT ...', value)
